title: Shipping Cost Estimator
description: Compare dimensional weight vs actual weight and price it across your own zone rates.
howto: Choose metric or imperial units and enter the parcel dimensions and actual weight.
Set the dimensional divisor (5000 for cm, 139 for in are standard).
Edit the zone table: each zone has a base price and a per-kg (or per-lb) rate.
Read the chargeable weight and the cost for every zone.

faqs.a: Carriers charge by whichever is greater: actual weight or (length x width x height) / divisor. Bulky light parcels are priced on their volume.
5000 is the common IATA divisor for cm/kg; 139 is common for in/lb. Your carrier may differ, so the field is editable.
No. Zone names and rates are editable samples. Enter your carrier's actual rate card for real quotes.
